title: NAFDAC Regulatory Assistant
description: Ask a question about anything NAFDAC has published. The Actor picks the relevant sections of nafdac.gov.ng, reads them live in a real browser, and answers with links to the official pages and documents.

query.title: Question
query.description: Your question in plain language. Examples: "What are the latest drug recalls?", "List products withdrawn by Nafdac", "What are the NAFDAC fees for product registration?"
query.prefill: What are the latest drug recalls?

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Upper bound on the number of records returned for list-style answers (alerts, recalls, table rows). Leave blank to let the actor use the number in the question ('top 5', 'last 10'), or a sensible default. Set explicitly to pin the count regardless of how the question is phrased.

defaultMaxResults.title: Default results per answer
defaultMaxResults.description: Fallback count for list-style answers when the question itself contains no number. Used only if Maximum results is blank. Example: set to 20 so 'latest recalls' returns 20 unless the user says 'top 5'. Leave blank for the built-in defaults (10 for alerts, 100 for tables, 25 for documents and registrations).

autoRoute.title: Choose sections automatically
autoRoute.description: Read the question and start the crawl in the matching NAFDAC sections (alerts, withdrawals, blacklists, guidelines, fees, news and so on). Recommended. Turn off to crawl only the URLs you provide.

startUrls.title: Extra start URLs (optional)
startUrls.description: Additional NAFDAC pages to crawl. These are visited in addition to the automatically chosen sections. Leave empty to use automatic routing only.

maxPages.title: Max pages to crawl
maxPages.description: Upper limit on pages and PDFs visited per run. Leave blank to let the Actor pick automatically.
maxPages.sectionDescription: Defaults work for most questions. Raise them for broad questions or long lists; lower them for a fast demo.

crawlDepth.title: Crawl depth
crawlDepth.description: How many link levels to follow from each starting page. 0 means only visit the starting pages themselves. Leave blank to let the Actor pick automatically.

pageTimeoutMs.title: Page timeout (ms)
pageTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for a single page to load.

debugHtml.title: Save debug HTML snapshots
debugHtml.description: Store the raw HTML of each crawled page in the key-value store. Useful for checking why an answer is missing something.
